This is a line plot illustrating the training loss over a number of iterations for six different model configurations. 

The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale. The visible tick marks range from 0 to 140,000 at regular intervals of 20,000. 
The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. 

There are six data series shown as solid lines, each surrounded by a lighter, semi-transparent shaded band of the same color. 
The purple line, labeled "Vanilla", starts at a value above 3.4 near iteration 0, exhibits a steep initial decline, and then follows a steady, gradual downward trend, ending at approximately 2.46 near iteration 140,000. 
The blue line, labeled "StrmLLM (n=64)", begins above 3.4, drops sharply, and steadily declines to roughly 2.61 by the end of the axis. 
The orange line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64)", starts above 3.4, experiences a steep initial drop, and steadily declines to about 2.52. 
The green line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)", begins above 3.4, drops sharply, and steadily declines to approximately 2.51. 
The red line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", starts above 3.4, drops sharply, and steadily declines to roughly 2.49. 
The dark blue line, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", begins above 3.4, drops sharply, and steadily declines to approximately 2.46 at the end of the plotted iterations.
